verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own site states that product releases can be segmented by user attributes to send targeted release notes, which matches the story directly. Its changelog also supports email subscriptions and embeddable widgets as delivery channels. The evidence is a single marketing-level claim with no detailed docs. Missing for 10: documentation of which user attributes can be used and how segments are configured, confirmation that segmentation applies to email and in-app delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can segment product release announcements by user attributes to send targeted release notes

citations.quote: Segment your product releases by user attributes to always send out targeted release notes.
